race.comment: NOT TELLING (4) turned in a sound effort last time but just found one better at Gold Coast over 1000m, beaten only half a length. Cherry-ripe fit now. Won't find this as tough and is sure to go very close to shedding the maiden tag. MISS VELCRO (9) is facing the starter for the first time but has shown ability at the trials and won't need to be a superstar to be competitive against this lot. Include from the inside alley. GOODFELLA FINCH (3) will be ready to peak now fourth run back and looks a must for the multiples. DIVINELLE (6) turned in a much better run at her second appearance last time out when 4.5 lengths from the winner in fourth over 800m at Ipswich. Can feature with natural improvement.
